Review the submitted output beside every score
A percentage on its own gives your reviewer little to examine. Your reviewer also needs to know how the score was produced.
Codility scores each submission against defined criteria.
The same submission always receives the same score, and no generative model decides which candidates pass.
For business-role tasks, Codility scores the candidate’s work against an expert-defined answer space.
For engineering tasks, Codility scores the code against test cases.
Your reviewer can open the submission itself next to the score. The AI Assistant is enabled or disabled per assessment, and every candidate interaction is captured as reviewable AI activity.
Your hiring manager can see how a result was produced before deciding who to interview.
The score, the submission and the AI activity, on one report.
Keep the record that supports the decision
A rejected candidate can ask your team why they did not advance. A questionnaire result gives your team little evidence to explain the decision.
For each candidate who takes the assessment, Codility stores the task, the submitted work and the scoring criteria together. The record remains available for the period set in your retention policy.
Codility’s platform and professional services offerings are designed to support compliance with New York City Local Law 144.
Codility does not use AI or machine learning to make automated employment decisions.
Codility applies deterministic and transparent scoring methods.
For engineering assessments, Codility prepares validation documentation suitable for procurement and legal review.
Your team can answer a challenged rejection with the task, the submitted work and the criteria used to produce the score.

Questions about pre-employment assessment tools
A pre-employment assessment tool is software an employer uses to evaluate candidates before making a hiring decision. Buyers also call this category pre-employment testing software. Assessments in this category commonly measure personality, cognitive ability or recalled knowledge. Codility instead gives the candidate a realistic task for the role and scores their work.
A personality test describes how a candidate reports they prefer to work. A pre-employment assessment platform such as Codility Screen puts the candidate into a realistic task and returns the output they produced, scored against defined criteria. Codility does not offer personality questionnaires or cognitive ability tests.
Codility assesses candidates for business and engineering roles. Business-role coverage includes functions such as customer support, customer success, sales, product management, product marketing, marketing, data analysis and finance. The task library grows every month. Engineering coverage spans the languages and frameworks your teams build in, and your team assigns tasks by skill and tech stack.
Candidates can use AI when your team allows it. Your team switches the AI Assistant on or off for each assessment. When the assistant is on, Codility captures every candidate interaction as reviewable AI activity, so your reviewer can see how the candidate used it.
Codility does not provide background checks, reference checks, credit checks or drug screening. Codility assesses the work a candidate produces in a task for the role.
Codility does not decide who to hire. Codility returns a score, the candidate’s submitted work and the evidence behind each integrity signal. A person on your team makes every hiring decision, and Codility uses no AI or machine learning to make automated employment decisions.
Codility connects with 21 major platforms, including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and SmartRecruiters. Your recruiters can invite candidates and read results without leaving the applicant tracking system.
Most customers are operational within four weeks. Before implementation, Codility scopes a free trial around your roles and hiring volume so your team can assess real candidates. A scoping call starts the trial process.
As part of professional services, Codility conducts adverse impact analyses using methods aligned with EEOC guidance, including the four-fifths rule and statistical testing. Codility’s published candidate research reports fairness ratings above 83% across every demographic group surveyed.
